retry_semantics.L: serial ACCEPT prefix writeback + retry commits from gap, no crossing unresolved gap
retry_semantics.W: retry whole-window rows re-decide commit prefix via retry detector; original whole rejection is not recovery success
retry_semantics.provenance: committed timestamps from actually written-back serial/retry rows (source: serial|retry, window, request_id)
retry_semantics.gate_c_v3: ① writeback changes subsequent state/request AND ② writeback contains >=1 retry-derived row (when retry executed)

baseline_vs_closed_loop_delta.same_denominator_note: baseline serial and selected closed-loop evaluate the same GT with the same n_units per song (denominator_n_units)
